src/index.ts.name: Package exports
src/index.ts.description: Lists everything other code can import from @kehto/paja: config files, launch options, simulation, host page, pointer resolution, parity lists, intent links, the dev server and LLM connection helpers.

src/multiplayer-config.ts.name: Multiplayer settings check
src/multiplayer-config.ts.description: Validates host multiplayer settings (ICE servers, CVM relays and family) from a file or the settings page; credentials never reach napplets.

src/options.ts.name: Launch options
src/options.ts.description: Checks raw launch options, including the experimental nested-frame lock, and turns them into the options and host config served to the page, with default host, port and timeouts.

src/parity.ts.name: Advertised NAP domains
src/parity.ts.description: Lists which NAP domains Paja may advertise and which services it needs, and finds any missing from a live shell.

src/simulation.ts.name: Simulated environment
src/simulation.ts.description: Turns flags or config into a complete simulated setup: identity, relays, storage, uploads, theme, config values and enabled domains.
